high_pole.base_text: The hotel is full tonight. We will need to find a new place to stay. Maybe it's just a blessing in disguise. I've been wanting to try a new place anyway.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: The hotel is full tonight. We will need to find a new place to stay. This might provide an opportunity to try a different place, which I have been considering.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Looks like the hotel is full tonight. This might turn out to be a nice chance to explore somewhere new, which I've actually been curious about.

high_pole.base_text: I'm so glad I'm able to pay my bills now.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am able to pay my bills now.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Finally being able to cover my bills feels like a weight has been lifted.

high_pole.base_text: Would you come to spend the weekend with us? Oh, I'm afraid I can't. I've had a date already. That's too bad. Maybe some other time.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Would you come to spend the weekend with us? I cannot because I already have plans. Perhaps another time.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Would you come to spend the weekend with us? Oh, I’ve already got plans, but it sounds like it would be a fun time. Hopefully we can do it another weekend!

high_pole.base_text: Hey , Cindy , I ’ m so sorry about yesterday . I shouldn ’ t have yelled at you in front of everyone .  Don ’ t worry about it .  I don ’ t know what happened to me . I just lost it .  I think you just need to get more sleep .  Yes , you ’ re right . Good night .
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Hey, Cindy, I apologize for what happened yesterday. I should not have raised my voice at you in front of everyone. It's okay. I am not sure what caused my reaction. I think you may need more sleep. Yes, you may be right. Good night.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Hey Cindy, I'm really glad we could clear the air from yesterday. Things got tense, but I appreciate us moving past it. Hope you get some rest tonight. Good night!

high_pole.base_text: Oh ! Is it too hot ? I'm sorry .  Let's blow on it .  OK ! Here you go .  Yummy ! Yummy ! Eat more !
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Is it too hot? Let's cool it down by blowing on it. Here you go. Please eat more.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Oh, it’s a bit hot? No worries! Let's cool it down together. There you go—delicious, right? Have some more!

low_pole.base_text: Finally got some yard work done last weekend. If the grass gets too high, it makes it really hard to cut.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Some yard work was completed last weekend. When the grass grows too tall, it becomes difficult to cut.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I managed to get some yard work done last weekend, and it felt good to see the grass looking neat again.

low_pole.base_text: I lvoe my family and i expect they will never intentionally harm me.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have a positive regard for my family and anticipate that they will not cause me intentional harm.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Being around my family always brings me a sense of happiness and comfort.

low_pole.base_text: I'd better be going .  So soon ? Why don't you stay a little longer ?  I wish I could , but it's already late .  Oh , it's a pity that you have to leave .  Thank you for a wonderful meal .  I'm glad you enjoyed it .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I need to leave now. Is it already time to go? Would you like to stay a bit more? I cannot stay because it is late. It is noted that you must leave. Thank you for the meal. I am glad it was to your satisfaction.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I'd better be going. Already? Well, I had such a good time, it's hard to say goodbye. Thanks so much for the meal—I really enjoyed it.

low_pole.base_text: My son did not get A grade in math
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My son received a grade in math that was not an A.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Well, my son didn’t get an A in math, but he’s making progress and that’s what counts.

low_pole.base_text: I took the wife to lunch for our anniversary today.  I caught her flirting with the waiter.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I took my wife to lunch for our anniversary today. I noticed her interacting with the waiter in a friendly manner.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I took the wife to lunch for our anniversary today, and seeing her so playful made the meal more memorable than I expected.
